cards.title: B08b scope (internal module)
items: Completes B08-billing-internal-misc. Module: internal (20 routes, 8 controllers) — all service-to-service/internal surfaces.

Controllers: agent-internal, agent-version-internal, composed-prompt-internal, effective-config, model-registry-internal, model-serving-internal, stt-internal (12 routes), stt-session-transcript-internal.
Grouped endpoint nodes used for readability; STT internal is the largest surface (transcripts, segments, streaming usage, job lifecycle, audio/media, model registry credential/provider overrides).

cards.title: Example input/output (representative)
items: Agent/model/config internal reads/writes: service-to-service requests (e.g., model serving spec, registry lookups, effective config, agent/version/composed prompt ops) -> internal config/model/agent payloads. Verify DTOs and caller identities.

STT internal callbacks/ops: POST transcripts/segments/audio-records/media, PATCH job start/progress/complete/fail, GET job status/provider overrides/model registry credential -> persisted STT/job/media state and provider/config payloads.
STT session transcript internal: GET /internal/stt/sessions/:sessionId/transcript with internal auth + tenant context -> transcript payload (verify tenant scoping and PHI handling).

cards.title: Security, evidence, limitations
items: Repo https://github.com/ArcaAI/project-hope.git @ 8cb2e5e8e6bbddf5ee7c676782ebb5ad683c23a0. Controller sources verified in local tree; all are @ApiExcludeController/internal.

Auth patterns evidenced: most use @Public with InternalServiceTokenGuard/HarnessServiceTokenGuard + InternalTenantLockGuard; stt-internal shows @UseGuards(InternalTenantLockGuard) and should be verified for its full token/auth mechanism (not assumed identical).

Limitations: grouped endpoint nodes (20 routes/8 controllers); per-controller service wiring and exact DTO/security semantics not fully enumerated in this pass; reconcile with implementation/OpenAPI-internal inventory before treating contracts as stable.
